method: GnuPG detached signature verification in an existing local Docker image with network disabled, read-only root filesystem, and a private temporary filesystem.
limitations: The key is not certified through a local web of trust; its exact primary fingerprint was checked against the official Swift active-keys page.
No native Linux compiler execution, hosted cache behavior, or runtime qualification is established by this signature check.
The existing linux/amd64 container ran on a local linux/arm64 Docker engine under emulation; only architecture-independent GPG verification was performed.

independentPythonVerification.method: PGPy cryptographic signature verification of detached signature; gpg unavailable on local macOS
limitations: PGPy warns that self-signature verification is incomplete.
PGPy does not implement revocation checks or key flags checks.
This is independent cryptographic pin verification; it does not substitute for the production GPG verification path, Linux execution, hosted cache qualification, or runtime testing.

gpgKeyring: Fresh private temporary keyring imported only the official Swift 6 release key. No existing user keyring was reused.
